name: tickets
description: Tickets to concerts, games, shows and other events, resold.

event.description: Which event, with its date and place as printed on the ticket.

howDealsGo: The buyer pays into escrow and releases once the ticket works at the door. A timer to the seller, set past the event, pays for a ticket that worked if the buyer goes quiet; if it did not work, the seller releases the money back. Before paying, check the ticket can be moved to a new name.
